description: Work submitted upstream and under active review: ergoplatform/ergo#2467 adds POST /wallet/signMessage and POST /utils/verifyMessage, using the sigma protocol the node already uses, with EIP-0028 style wrapping so a message signature can not be turned into a transaction proof. Retargeted to the v6.0.10 release branch on 2026-10-24 at the maintainer's request; all review comments addressed. Renews #66, closed as a stale reservation on 2026-10-14 while the PR was still in review.
